claim: For every field \(k\), all weight-zero Rota–Baxter operators \(P\) on \(A=k[t]/(t^3)\) are exactly \(P(1)=at+bt^2\), \(P(t)=ct^2\), \(P(t^2)=0\), with \(a(a-2c)=0\). For each finite field \(\mathbb F_q\), their number is \(q^2\) in characteristic two and \(q(2q-1)\) in odd characteristic; up to conjugation by \(\operatorname{Aut}_{\mathbb F_q}(A)\), the numbers of classes are \(q+2\) and \(q+4\), respectively. All such operators satisfy \(P^3=0\); there are precisely \(q(q-1)\) operators with \(P^2\ne0\) in odd characteristic, and none in characteristic two.
integrity: An explicit all-field proof is accompanied by exact finite-field tests. No external independent audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Weight-zero only; no claim for truncation degree four or higher.
The orbit count is for finite fields, although the normal form holds over all fields.
A bounded literature comparison does not establish exhaustive priority.
title: Weight-zero Rota–Baxter operators on the cubic truncated polynomial algebra
